mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.nickname, sf.url AS avatar_url, u.preferred_activity_types, u.preferred_experience_types, u.activity_reminder_enabled, u.system_notification_enabled, u.points, u.status, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN stored_file sf ON u.avatar_file_id = sf.id WHERE u.id=#{id}
